dataset: Observed-only ADS-B ground-speed flight mileage benchmarks for the Gleason flat-disk map

source.attribution: Contains data from the adsb.lol open ADS-B archive; ODbL 1.0.

measurement.target: Directly observed flown mileage from recorded ADS-B ground speed and timestamps
measurement.method: Integrate step-interpolated path_gs values only across accepted contiguous intervals. Coverage is measured against the complete flight start_ts-to-end_ts duration, including missing time before the first and after the last telemetry sample. Do not bridge gaps, expand partial observations, or impute missing speed.
measurement.units: ground speed in knots; elapsed time in seconds; nautical miles converted to kilometres using 1.852
explicitlyNotUsed: great-circle, spherical, ellipsoidal, or geodesic calculations
scheduled flight times or estimated cruise-speed averages
measurement.airportBoundaryUse: Airport airspace polygons, or a 20 km airport-centred fallback circle, are used only by the source API to identify flights departing and arriving at the selected airports. Airport coordinates are retained only as map endpoints. No airport or trajectory coordinates enter the track-distance integration.
